strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
Princess Romina, we've arrived at the Mars Frontier Base.
Heh, brings back memories.
...We're back, huh.
Before the Meganoids could start meddling with this place,
looks like we managed to crush that base.
Good... Looks like the Meganoids haven't made a move on it yet.
A frontier base, huh... It's got a different feel from the colonies...
Indeed... Once its development is complete,
I imagine this place will become a colony too.
Well, it looks peaceful here for now. Yes, yes, very good, very good.
Sorry to spoil the mood... but I'm picking up multiple mech signatures.
Whaaat!?
Nuhahaha! My, my, thank you for all your hard work, Londo Bell!
This is... a Za Boom mech!
We're surrounded!? Where did that transmission come from?
It seems to be from that ship... Putting it through.
Ohh, well, well, all of you together. How good of you to come all this way.
The Commander of the Mars Frontier Base... Hazard Pasha, is it?
Indeed. That alien ship... Did you swipe it from those fellows?
I have a question too.
Why is the Commander of the Mars Frontier Base leading a Za Boom unit?
Oh no, no, you see, I'm actually their prisoner.
They threatened me into urging Londo Bell to surrender...
Those Za Boom creeps are dirty!
Idiot, what are you doing swallowing his lies whole?
...We got intel about this just the other day, didn't we?
You bastard, Hazard!
We know you're in bed with the Meganoids and Za Boom!
A well-seasoned performance, I must say.
However... we've already confirmed the truth of it, yes.
...If you surrender, I will see to it that you receive a trial,
Commander Hazard.
Oh-ho, as expected of Londo Bell, famed for its compassion.
Your kindness makes me so very happy, it brings tears to my eyes.
But... I can't back down either!
You mean you'll fight us!?
That's right. Once I've disposed of you lot,
even the Bunker and the Gyandlar will have to respect me!
(With Annex dead and the Meganoids having cut me loose,
if I don't get my hands on their forces, I have no future!)
Hazard, you...! Like hell I'll let you have Mars! Mike, Lenny!
Yeah, let's corner that Hazard creep for good this time!
Right! Let's go!
Whoa, hold on, Joe. Looks like your Kurojishi can't sortie.
Huh!? Why not!?
That's the thing, nobody knows. Even the maintenance crew's stumped.
What the hell is that!?
(Was it 'cause I tried to move it the other day...?
Nah... It didn't even move anyway.)
Can't be helped... Leave this to us and wait quietly, Joe.
Yeah, yeah.
Maybe it's because you never take proper care of it?
Damn it! ...At a time like this!
It can't be helped. Joe, you'll stand by here.
All hands, prepare to sortie. We're moving out.
No... Not me... M-My Emperor...!
Hazard! Give it up!
Hazard! Give it up!
N-No! Me, finished in a place like this! In a backwater like Mars...!
Mars might be a backwater... but it's our irreplaceable home!
I'll show them all!
Those Earth people who... who treated me like a nuisance...
Those Federation people who exiled me to Mars...! I... I...!
Hmm... Looks like the tide's turned against me...
Heh! We can take you even without Big Bro!
Prepare yourself, Hazard!
...Heh heh heh... A pity Joe Maya isn't here, but...
Charm! Ilbora! Sortie!
Heh heh heh, it seems you've split up your forces, Londo Bell...
This battle is ours!
This... looks like an ambush.
Sure looks like it... and there's a heap of 'em, too.
It galls me to take orders from Hazard... but... Joe!
Ilbora...!?
Ilbora!
Big Bro, it's that black one that got away last time... It's him!
I know! Damn it, why can't the Kurojishi launch at a time like this!
Joe...! Why haven't you come out!?
Ilbora, don't fixate on one foe. The Elshank coming out suits us fine...
I'll finish them all at once!
...The Elshank...
...No, I can't go back! I can never go back...!
Ilbora...
Damn... Just sitting here twiddling my thumbs...!
Our battle... I never imagined it would be settled like this.
But I'll show no mercy...! Here I come, Joe!
T-Tobikage!? Whoa!?
Wh-What!? That light!?
What happened!? Report!
No idea, there was a light on the bridge...
P-Princess... Joe is...
...Joe... vanished...?
What is this place...? Don't tell me...
Am I inside the Tobikage...?
Joe!? Are you there!? What's happened, Joe!
Don't worry about me, Princess Romina.
...I don't know why, but right now I'm... inside the Tobikage.
Joe!? Really!?
Big Bro!
...Heh heh... Joe, just as I was chosen by the Zerokage...
you have been chosen by the Tobikage.
Heh, guess so, Ilbora...!
Let's settle this, Joe!
Bring it on!
Damn, I gotta...!
Damian!?
I'm heading to the hangar!
I've gotta at least learn to move the Kurojishi!
Trouble, new enemies...!
C'mon, just how many enemies does Mars have!?
New enemies... So they're a different bunch from these guys?
Seems like we always run into trouble wherever people gather, huh.
It's the opposite. The enemies are coming after us...
Bring it on!
I'll smash you with my Gekigan Flare!
Can we identify the enemy?
(Heh heh, my luck hasn't run out yet... If I use this chaos...)
Heh heh.
Scouting the Earthlings' base, and we stumble on a big catch.
That's... a Jovian unit!
A troublesome enemy's shown up...
Evil Earthlings like you! I'll bury you right here!
Don't give me that crap! We're the ones protecting Earth!
Silence! There is only one justice, and it lies with the Jovian Alliance!
Cut the crap! You drag Earth and Mars into this... and call it justice!?
If you'd never attacked us in the first place...!
Akito...
Akito...
I'd just have become a cook... Nobody would've had to die...
Even Ai wouldn't have had to die! I'll never forgive you!
All units, engage the Jovian Alliance as well!
Joe... You, fusing with the Tobikage... I'll admit, I'm surprised.
Heh, nobody's more surprised than me.
Ilbora, this fight between us... ends here...!
That was my intention all along. Come, Joe...!
Joe! Ilbora!
Princess...
Ah... Why, Shaff?
Why must those two try to kill each other!?
Ilboraaa! Knock it off already! ...Think about how Princess Romina feels!
...Joe... Joe Maya...
Wh-What...?
You... You of all people have no right to say that!!
Tch... No good. Guys with their blood up are a pain.
Look who's talking.
Ilbora... Why...
Joe...! You... You of all people...!
Ilbora! Where are you going...!
Ilbora...! Wait...
...You idiot...!
Did we get one of their officers!?
Yeah.
All right! Now there's just Annex left!
Just a little more... a little more...!
(Emperor Annex is dead, and now Charm's gone and croaked too...
That's the end of the Za Boom Army... This is bad, very bad...)
Blast it, justice cannot lose...!
Stop! You can't fight in that machine anymore! You'll get yourself killed!
Just quit already!
Silence! We of the Jovian Superior Human Corps do not fear death!
What good will dying do!? Please, retreat!
There's no reason for humans to fight each other!
Ngh... Shown mercy by Earthlings... No choice. We're retreating!
Blast it, justice cannot lose...!
What are you saying! Push it any further and you'll die!
That's right. There ain't no shame in retreatin' here.
Silence! We of the Jovian Superior Human Corps do not fear death!
What good will dying do!? Please, retreat,
there's no reason for humans to fight each other!
Ngh... Shown mercy by Earthlings... No choice. We're retreating!
Tch... And they don't even seem like the type you can't talk to...
They... don't seem like people who can't be reasoned with...
It's over...
Yeah... That Hazard bastard... doing something so stupid...
Kinda... feel a little sorry for him...
Yeah... He was a creep, but... for him to die...
...Exiled to Mars, killed here... he brought it all on himself.
Let's just think of it that way.
Yeah... I know, but... damn it!
Joe...
Looked like one of the Za Boom machines got away, though?
The Zerokage, he called it... A machine not to be underestimated...
Big Bro, you okay?
Don't worry. No way the Tobikage and me are gonna lose.
Huh... So a pilot can actually get inside the Tobikage?
I wanna ride it too...
No way, no way. They said "the Tobikage chose him," remember?
I bet only Joe can ride it.
Grrrr!
TOOOBIKAGE FIIINGERRR!! ...That's what I wanted to do!
Where there's light, there's shadow... Behind the chosen, the unchosen...
I think Yamada's problem starts way before that...
Ilbora... huh.
That pilot... I sensed a little hesitation...
Hesitation... you say?
Yes... I can't be sure, but probably...
Princess Romina... Perhaps Lord Ilbora is troubled as well...
Yes... ...Ilbora...
The escaped machine worries me, but the Jovians are getting active too.
Those guys won't shut up about justice this, justice that.
Justice, justice, huh...
You'd better remember this too, Kappei, all of you.
When people blindly believe in a single set of values, they run wild...
just like the Meganoids.
Set of val...? Blind-lee...?
He means it's unwise to turn up your nose at ideas without a taste, sir.
What, it's about food? Then I'm more worried about Big Bro Uraki.
I-I just don't like carrots, that's all.
In any case, the frontier base should be safe for the time being.
All right, we're heading for our next destination. All units, return.
...Ilbora...
